messages:
emma li: Quick sync 99We're gating the public v1->v2 deprecation on two things: docs PRs merged (snippets updated) and telemetry checks for model-swap recall. Freeze snippets Tue 9am PT.
peter yang: I can take release notes + customer-facing FAQ. Also recommending an embargoed changelog entry that we flip live when the public email goes out.
kevin rao: I'll own telemetry. Plan: run a recall sweep comparing redwood-embed-v1->v2 on 200 sample queries and surface top-k recall delta. Will post results as CSV in the PR comments. Also adding a smoke check: API should return 200 for typical calls, and 422 for embed dim mismatch.
emma li: Great. Can docs show the exact command we use so customers can reproduce? e.g.:
```bash
redwood-metrics recall-check --from redwood-embed-v1 --to redwood-embed-v2 --sample-file samples.txt --out recall-report.csv
```
peter yang: We'll include a short "How we measured" blurb describing sample selection and thresholds (acceptable recall drop < 2%). If recall drop > 2% we pause rollout and notify eng-ml.
docs-ci-bot: docs-ci: PR #4122 (migration/deprecate-v1-snippets) opened by @emma-li  preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/migration/v1-to-v2 -- lint ok.
kevin rao: For the migration guide, add a telemetry appendix explaining the metrics: avg similarity, top1/top5 recall, index size change, and a note about reindex time estimates. I'll attach a sample CSV.
emma li: Also adding a short doc snippet for the compat shim removal steps and a checklist for sample apps: update client init, run smoke tests, run recall-check, update CI snapshot tests.
peter yang: Ops note: Dedicated tenants can request a pinned v1 route for 14 days post-publication. Add contact: support+dedicated@redwood.ai.
emma li: Final: tag @kevin when PRs are ready so we can publish telemetry results alongside the public announcement. I'll merge once localization and CI previews look good.
docs-ci-bot: docs-ci: PR #4122 build passed on staging; ready for review.
